checks.message: Submitted boundary uses the repository-registered provisional constraint (official_boundary=false, geometry_role=provisional_constraint); it supports intake and content scoring but must be replaced with the official redline and all areas recomputed before professional scoring.

Three required key areas (Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin Community, Dazhongsi) are present as provisional constraints; they are non-overlapping and inside the site boundary, but must be replaced with official polygons before professional scoring.
Land-use polygons form a planar partition of the site boundary (polygonize from shared cut lines), with no gaps or overlaps; areas recomputed in EPSG:4548.
All known metrics recompute from geometry in EPSG:4548; unknown regulatory controls (FAR, building height) are explicitly marked pending official conditions.
Static offline HTML with inline SVG, no remote scripts/fonts/tiles/API calls; displayed values carry data-metric markers matching metrics.json.
Primary zh proposal has a complete en counterpart; figures, report HTML, visual HTML and A3/A0 PDFs all have zh+en display pairs.
Proposal cites standards, design-depth items, geometry, metrics, sources and assumptions; every required chapter carries at least one relevant evidence marker.
All geometry is based on provisional rough boundaries; no area, redline, statutory or implementation claim is made from them.
